limitations: Metadata tokens are build-local coordinates and are only meaningful with the reported artifact SHA-256 and MVID.
CIL instruction anchors are decoded from file-backed method bodies only; no target assembly is loaded or executed.
Exported types are reported from ExportedType rows as declared; forwarded types are not resolved in their implementing assemblies.
User strings are the #US literals loaded by ldstr in the inspected method bodies, with their own coverage; instruction anchors and normalized CIL digests keep their build-local tokens.

Member signatures decode ECMA-335 primitive, class, valuetype, generic instantiation, generic variable, pointer, byref, single-dimension and general array, function pointer, custom modifier, and typed reference forms; class and valuetype operands keep their encoded TypeDefOrRefOrSpec values, and unsupported forms such as vararg sentinels retain raw signature hashes.

Types, fields, methods, call edges, field accesses, and user strings cover only the selected declaring types; coverage describes that selection. Edge targets outside it keep their names but are not described.

native_semantics_and_corrections:
Phase 2 native-body findings (read-only original GameAssembly / existing Ghidra DB)

DOT trigger pipeline:
TriggerConditionMet 0x181A70820 snapshots all persistentData whose TriggerConditionInstances contains the reported condition object. ApplyTriggeredEffect 0x181A713D0 processes this snapshot serially. Each instance gets a new BattleEffectContext and iterates effect.ApplyEffects (+0x48). Child effects run serially through ApplyEffect 0x181A716A0 and the ordinary module.ApplyToValidTargets pipeline. There is no ability-level evasion reroll or cached-evader filter in this path.
Child module owner is persistentController._owner (+0x70), i.e. the status host. Effect.Creator remains separate; damage SOURCE_OVERRIDE_CREATOR and STAT_OVERRIDE_CREATOR flags choose attribution and stat source respectively. Child target input is battleContext.BattleUnitsController.AllUnits (+0x98), with an extra special mode branch; normal SELF rules therefore select the status host. Child stacking override wins if nonempty, otherwise inherits parent's stackingLine.
Trigger completion callback 0x181A752C0 resets only the reported condition AFTER all child effects finish, then releases the temporary snapshot. AutoTriggerEffect 0x181A70E40 selects entries in the same effect-type group with matching definition ID, runs the same child pipeline, and its completion releases the list (no reported-condition reset).

Trigger/expiry event order:
Persistent.Initialize 0x181A6B820 registers trigger tracker (+0x80) before expiration tracker (+0x78). Unit.TriggerCondition 0x181BCCD50 invokes the unit event. ProcessCondition 0x1816BA910 evaluates and fires the emitting tracker, then separately evaluates same-unit leader trackers. It is NOT one global queue across all trackers. Within a batch, RunInsertionSort 0x1816BB040 sorts descending priority, preserving ties (only swaps on strict less-than). Therefore ordinary same START_OF_TURN trigger executes before the expiration tracker handles that event. FULL_TURN_COMPLETE and OR-expiration semantics are in prior effect_recovery evidence.
StartUnitTurn 0x181931FC0 emits runtime START_OF_TURN=23 before continuing ability selection. It checks current HP afterward; a dead current unit follows the transition path rather than selecting an ability. TriggerTurnStarted 0x18193B880 additionally rejects dead, PARALYSIS, and fled units.

MODIFY_STAT snapshot and aggregation:
GetPersistentEffectAmount 0x18136B690 normal stat branch reads target.GetInitialUnitCalculatedStat(stat), calls effect.GetStatEffectAmount 0x180FF51B0, then adds context contribution. For runtime MODIFY_STAT=4, amount=initialStat*Multiplier+Flat. Stored persistentData.Amount is an absolute delta, not an unevaluated percentage. Other flags can select current-stat or raw-limit calculation and must not be silently treated as the normal branch.
GetAffectedAmount 0x181A6F040 processes matching type=4/stat, with selector 0x181A750A0: per stackingLine, ordinary buff selects MAX amount, ordinary debuff selects MIN amount; sum selected amounts across lines and both dictionaries. Taunt stat62 has a dedicated exception. Multiple same-line speed-down instances coexist but their amounts do not sum.
IStatSource.GetCompoundableStatContribution 0x181BCEA70 tailcalls GetAffectedAmount. GetStatValue 0x181BBAE00 supplies initial calculated value to the shared stat calculator, then applies stat limits. For SPEED without other contributions this is initialSpeed + aggregated absolute delta, with the calculator's integer conversion for SPEED.

Stacking line:
GetStackingLineOverride 0x181A72B70 returns definition.StackingLineOverride verbatim, except distinct-stacking-line creates Guid text; empty returns empty. GetStackingLine 0x181A72A70 uses this when nonempty; otherwise normal moves use the literal ability-stacking-line, leader move3 concatenates leader-ability-stacking-line + source.UnitDO.Id, unique move6 selects unique-stacking-line if GameConstants.UseUniqueAbilityStackingLine is true, otherwise ability-stacking-line. Literal mappings verified against il2cpp/dump/il2cpp.json, not inferred from name.

Tag trigger:
PersistentEffectTagAdded 0x181BC9110 emits runtime26 (protobuf28 PERSISTENTEFFECTADD) with the added tag and source. ConditionStatus.IsMatch 0x1817DC710 compares nonempty conditionValue to IBattleTagConditionEventArgs.Tag exactly, or Any exact equal in IBattleTagsConditionEventArgs.Tags. This is not an effect-ID comparison. The wattambor_trigger_dots condition requires that actual event tag.

Manual ability trigger fields:
AbilityContext.IsAbilityReady 0x1816A1B50 checks cooldown or ultimate threshold, not AbilityDefinition.Triggers. PlayerManualAbilitySelected 0x18193A440 does not roll Triggers either. A proven consumer is AbilityTrackerController 0x1816A29E0 / 0x1816A2BB0 used by leader automatic execution; all trigger conditions must be met there. No claim is made that Force Crush's CHANCE50 is a recovered AI selection rule.

AOE:
Comparator 0x18136B8B0 sorts UnitDO.Definition.SquadPositionPriority (+0x170) ascending. Ability.CanBeApplied 0x18184C080 calls each module.CanBeApplied with previousTargets=null and aggregates valid targets by module.ApplyType. This is the ability-level evasion candidate input, not all units indiscriminately.

All *.c files have corresponding *_listing.txt bounded by metadata function range. Ghidra can follow tail-jumps into other native functions in C output; prefer bounded assembly for those edges. Temporary float-return annotations were rolled back. All project sessions closed without saving. No runtime files changed, no git operations, no API/network use.

APPENDED CORRECTIONS / HELPER CLOSURE (final review)

Tracker granularity clarification: there are TWO persistent condition trackers PER UNIT, not two trackers per persistent state. All state trigger conditions belong to that unit's shared trigger tracker; all state expiration conditions belong to its shared expiration tracker. An implementation that loops stateA.trigger, stateA.expiry, stateB.trigger, stateB.expiry is incorrect. Collect and sort all matching triggers for the unit first, then process the unit's expiration tracker. Priority comparisons are descending and stable within each tracker.

Tag-added correction: persistent_add_effect.c 0x181A6BF00 raises EffectTagInstanceAdded (+0x30 callback) for every new instance. It raises EffectTagAdded (+0x20 callback) ONLY when the tag's reference count becomes 1. Thus protobuf28 PERSISTENTEFFECTADD is a first-tag-presence event, NOT an event for every added state. Per-instance event is protobuf50 PERSISTENTEFFECTADDINSTANCE. IsMatch empty/null conditionValue is wildcard; a numeric value is the trigger count and does not require string tag equality. Otherwise tag equality applies.

Previously unknown tag-helper semantics are now proved by native bodies:
- active_tag_any.c 0x181A6E300: ANY provided tag with referenceCount>0; empty list returns false.
- required_tag_target.c 0x181BB2A30: ALL tags active; empty list returns true.
- required_tag_exclude.c 0x181BB2BC0: NONE of tags active; empty list returns true.
PassesAllChecks checks ordinary positive list only when nonempty and negates ANY for ordinary negative list. The code's ordinary-positive ANY / ordinary-negative NONE / required-positive ALL / required-negative NONE is therefore correct (factory translates absent arrays into empty lists).

Previously unknown buff/debuff classification is now proved:
Definition.IsPersistentBuff 0x180FF5C50:
  FORCE_BUFF(bit14) -> true; else FORCE_DEBUFF(bit15) -> false.
  MODIFY_STAT(runtime4): TAUNT(stat62)->true; otherwise inspect definition fields in order multiplier, contextMultiplier, additive. First not Approximately(value,0) determines buff=(value>0); all approximately0 ->false.
  RECOVER(runtime5): if recoverType!=1 true; otherwise same three-field sign rule.
  IMMUNITY(runtime6), GRANT_SHIELD(runtime17) ->true.
  HEALTH_LIMIT(runtime19) ->MIN_HEALTH_LIMIT(bit24).
  STAT_LIMIT(runtime22), runtime41 ->MIN_STAT_LIMIT(bit33).
  Other runtime types ->false.
Definition.IsPersistentDebuff 0x180FF5DD0:
  FORCE_BUFF ->false (wins even if both force flags set); else FORCE_DEBUFF ->true.
  Runtime0(PARALYSIS),1(CURSE)->true.
  Runtime4(MODIFY_STAT)->!IsPersistentBuff().
  Runtime41->MAX_STAT_LIMIT(bit34).
  Other types ->false.
For SPEED specifically: positive nonzero multiplier normally buff; negative or all-zero coefficients debuff. Positive multiplier plus FORCE_DEBUFF remains debuff. Classification is not determined by stored Amount sign. This also controls resistance bypass (buff bypasses) and strongest-per-stacking-line aggregation (buff MAX, debuff MIN).

All final helper reads were from the same existing Ghidra project, read-only and closed without saving. The earlier review's unknown OR/AND and classification findings are superseded by these bodies, not by assumptions.
